title: Portrait Gallery
text: The painter sets up his easel in the long gallery, where the House's dead look down in oils. One of the House refuses to sit. The painter only smiles; it does not matter, he says, for he painted them long ago. He turns a canvas around to show them.

options.label: Insist that they sit for him, to learn what he painted long ago.

outcomes.text: The portrait shows something the sitter did not mean to show, standing just behind them.
The painter leaves in the night. The portrait's eyes have been scratched out from inside the canvas.

options.label: Let it be; some faces are better left unpainted.

outcomes.text: The painter paints the hound instead. The hound will not go into the gallery again.
